mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, nickname, avatar, gender, birthday, real_name, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (id, user_id, nickname, avatar, gender, birthday, real_name, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{realName}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update:
UPDATE user_profile
nickname = #{nickname}, avatar = #{avatar}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, real_name = #{realName}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
